npcs.name: Ansel Wick
npcs.actionData: The careened ship by the water has been "almost ready" for three years.

npcs.name: Bosun Eli Marrow
npcs.actionData: I run passengers back to the mainland. Wispmeyer's the short trip. Plymouth takes longer, but it's the way to go if you're headed for the west of the mainland.

npcs.name: Harbor Watch
npcs.actionData: Every ship pays its berth here, flag or no flag.

npcs.name: Ruth Calloway
npcs.actionData: Fresh fish in the morning, rum by noon, and a fight by sundown. That's a normal day here.

npcs.name: Dacey Lorne
npcs.actionData: Captain Carrow's rule is simple. Inside the port you settle a quarrel with coin, not a blade.

npcs.name: Port Warden
npcs.actionData: Keep your blade sheathed inside the port. Out in the jungle you can do what you like.

npcs.name: Jory Tamsin
npcs.actionData: Most of the ships in this harbor fly no flag at all. That's the point of the place.

npcs.name: Loveday Marsh
npcs.actionData: We get rain every afternoon. Give it an hour and it's gone.

npcs.name: Perrin Gale
npcs.actionData: Those monkeys will steal anything that isn't nailed down, and some things that are.
